data.gender_notes: Mahnaz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-z', meaning 'grace' or 'gracefulness'. In Islamic culture, the name Mahnaz symbolizes the delicate, elegant, and refined nature of a woman. It is also a reminder of the grace and elegance that Allah bestows upon His creation. The name Mahnaz carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate, Elegant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahnaz usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate, elegant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
